sections.label: Infrastructure & Utilities
sections.summary: Multiple critical utility and transformer clearance dimensions, details, and documentation are missing from plans, including dimensions for outer conductors, building setbacks, driveway vertical clearances, transformer pad specifications, access clearances, and utility coordination details.
